why_withheld: COIG-CQIA declares no licence, and its rows are user-written text from Chinese platforms; redistribution is not permitted

instruction_corpus_zh.jsonl.note: each withheld row is COIG-CQIA's instruction as question and its output as answer, exactly; rebuild_training_corpus.py restores it

instruction_corpus_translated.jsonl.note: each withheld row carries an English translation, made for this study by machine translation, of a COIG-CQIA row (its Chinese original is in zh_question and zh_answer). The translation is derived from text that may not be redistributed, so it is not published and cannot be regenerated exactly; the training corpus cannot be rebuilt from public sources. line_sha256 lets anyone holding a withheld line verify it.
